answer_1.quote: Our goal is to train abstractive summarization systems that generate both faithful and informative summaries in an end-to-end fashion.

answer_2.quote: Evaluation Metrics. QuestEval is used as the main metric to evaluate summaries' factual consistency.

answer_4.quote: We recruit the two human annotators for our summary error study, as well as another experienced annotator, to evaluate summary informativeness and factual consistency.
answer_4.guideline: For each article, the judges are shown summaries generated by the CRSENTROPY model and four other systems. They then rate each system summary against the CRSENTROPY summary... label whether the system summary is better or worse than the baseline summary for informativeness and factual consistency.
